data.body_html:
Marbella Pride 2046 is set to be the biggest celebration on the Costa del Sol, and there's no better way to join the party than with a Marbella Pride boat rental Puerto Banús 2046. Whether you're planning a daytime cruise with friends or a sunset celebration with rainbow flags flying, our fleet of private yachts offers an unforgettable experience on the Mediterranean. With prices starting at €749 for 2 hours, every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and all taxes — no surprises, just pure Pride energy.

Puerto Banús is the epicentre of Marbella's Pride festivities, and our boats depart directly from the marina, putting you steps away from the main events. From intimate gatherings on a 5-person speedboat to full-scale parties on a 12-guest Mangusta, we have options for every group size and budget. Below, you'll find everything you need to plan your perfect Pride charter.

Why Choose a Boat Rental for Marbella Pride 2046?

Marbella Pride attracts thousands of visitors every year, and the coastline becomes a vibrant hub of celebration. Renting a private boat gives you the freedom to escape the crowds while still being part of the action. You can anchor near the beach parties at Cabopino, cruise past the Golden Mile, or drop anchor at Cala del Faro for a swim. The Mediterranean in June averages 25°C water temperature and 30°C air temperature — ideal for sunbathing, swimming, and dancing on deck.

Our charters are fully inclusive: you get a licensed skipper who handles navigation, a cooler stocked with water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, and cava, plus light snacks. No hidden costs for fuel, insurance, or the 21% Spanish IVA. Just show up with your guests and celebrate Pride your way.

We operate a diverse fleet from Puerto Banús, ranging from 5 to 12 guests. Here are the most popular choices for Pride charters:

For the best value, Tier A boats (Astondoa 40 and Azimut 39) are perfect for groups of 9–11. If you want a jet ski included, the Mangusta 80 (white or grey) is the only option with that bonus. All other boats are priced on request — just message us via WhatsApp for a quote.

Sample Itinerary: A Pride Day on the Water

Most charters run 2, 4, or 8 hours. Here's a typical 4-hour Pride itinerary departing Puerto Banús at 12:00:

  • 12:00 — Depart Puerto Banús, pass the iconic luxury yachts and the statue of the bull.
  • 12:30 — Cruise east towards Marbella Marina and the Golden Mile, with views of La Concha mountain.
  • 13:00 — Anchor at Cala Cortés or Cabopino for swimming, snorkelling, and lunch.
  • 14:00 — Raise a glass of cava for a Pride toast; music on deck, photos with rainbow flags.
  • 15:00 — Head back to Puerto Banús, passing the beach clubs of Río Verde.
  • 16:00 — Disembark and walk to the Pride parade or after-party.

Longer 8-hour charters allow you to reach Estepona or Sotogrande, with a beach stop for lunch at a chiringuito.

What’s Included in Your Pride Charter

Every booking includes the following — no add-ons, no surprises:

  • Licensed English-speaking skipper
  • Fuel for the full duration
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava
  • Light snacks (chips, olives, nuts)
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21%) included in the price

You are welcome to bring your own food, decorations, or a Bluetooth speaker. Just let us know if you need a cooler for extra supplies.

How to Book for Marbella Pride 2046

Booking is simple. Send us a WhatsApp message with your preferred date, group size, and desired duration. We'll confirm availability and send a quote. For Tier A boats, you can book directly at the fixed prices. For all other boats, we'll provide a custom quote within hours.

We recommend booking at least 2–3 weeks in advance for Pride week, as slots fill quickly — especially sunset cruises and weekend dates. A 50% deposit secures your booking, with the balance due 48 hours before departure.

For more inspiration, check out our main boat rental page to see the full fleet and read about other Marbella experiences.
